title: [UI-Kit] Focus indicators — WCAG 1.4.11 / 2.4.7
verdict_basis: The ring mechanism is delivered and correct: one token set, one mixin, keyboard-only semantics, and a ring that resolves and recolours on every surface measured. The two findings are a palette decision (VCST-5946) and a pre-existing control defect (VCST-5947), neither an implementation defect in PR #2468. Operator-confirmed disposition.

bugs_not_filed.finding: Escape does not close the Ship-to popover
bugs_not_filed.reason: Pre-existing; it is a popover not a modal, so ECL-15.1 does not bite.

bugs_not_filed.finding: PDP gallery arrows carry native disabled=true alongside aria-disabled=false
bugs_not_filed.reason: Swiper writes the DOM attribute directly, bypassing the component binding. Native disabled wins for AT, so impact is nil.

bugs_not_filed.finding: Dead image host on one PDP (starmarket-platform.demo.govirto.com)
bugs_not_filed.reason: Test-data drift, not a product defect. Worth a seeder cleanup.

bugs_not_filed.finding: VcSelect appears to open its listbox on keyboard focus alone
bugs_not_filed.reason: INVESTIGATED AND WITHDRAWN. Two lanes disagreed; the deeper check won. The trigger is an input that sets aria-expanded on focus — standard ARIA combobox behaviour. The sibling hypothesis was also disproved: all 21 closed .vc-popover__content nodes have offsetParent === null, so they are not in the tab order.

This PR closed that latent hazard.
